subject: MAP re-scope and slippage waterfall — proposed rebaseline & escalation
messages:
From: Danielle Brooks <danielle@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v2 draft — timeline concern

Marissa,

Thanks for the MAP v2 — I've reviewed the milestones and want to flag a procurement gating point on our side. Our security review team pushed back on the private deployment checklist (KMS/HSM attestation) and said they need an extra 7 business days of evidence and a short technical walkthrough. That will shift the acceptance window.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide an abbreviated evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt + network diagram + per-route logging sample) by Friday so we can fast-track the review? Also, can we talk through the acceptance criteria so we don't accidentally block the cutover?

Alex — looping you since procurement owns the timeline on our end.

Appreciate it,
Danielle
Director of IT Security
Acme Health

----
Attachment: eval-plan-annotated.pdf (pdf stub, 120KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 draft — timeline concern

Danielle — thanks for the heads up and the specificity. We can assemble the evidence packet and schedule a 45-minute walkthrough with our Security Engineer (Karthik) tomorrow afternoon.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Today: deliver SOC2 excerpt, network diagram, and sample per-route logs (redacted) — attachment: 2027-09-15_MAP-v2.xlsx contains the updated MAP with gated items highlighted.
- Thu 09/16 2:00pm PT: technical walkthrough with Karthik + internal engineer (45m)
- Fri 09/17: confirmation of security sign-off or list of remaining items; if sign-off granted, acceptance window remains as-is. If additional evidence is requested, estimate +7 business-day shift and propose updated go-live of 2027-10-10.

I want to be explicit about risk: procurement gating on KMS/HSM attestation is the single highest-probability slip in this plan. If we get a formal ask for HSM validation post-sign, that would require procurement re-approval and could add another 10+ business days. We should plan contingency paths.

Would you like us to prepare a fallback (hosted-only) acceptance lane so you can start functional validation earlier while we finalize private deployment onboarding?

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: 2027-09-15_MAP-v2.xlsx (excel stub, 42KB)
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Danielle Brooks <danielle@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 draft — timeline concern

Marissa, Danielle,

Thanks — walkthrough scheduled. Quick internal note: procurement would prefer not to change the go-live outside current quarter if possible. That said, security is firm on the HSM attestation bit — they will not sign acceptance without it. Danielle, if the hosted-only lane is available for functional validation, procurement may accept a phased approach (phase 1: hosted eval; phase 2: private deploy).

One more thing — if the private timeline slips, I need to understand our options on the commercial side. Is there any flexibility on the start-of-service billing date or a short credit for a compressed acceptance window? We want to keep execs comfortable.

Alex
VP Procurement
Acme Health
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acmehealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 draft — timeline concern

Alex — hi all, Karthik here (Security/Onboarding). Short answers:
- We can provide HSM attestation artifacts and a short validation checklist by EOD today.
- Walkthrough confirmed Thu 9/16 2:00pm PT — I'll cover KMS/HSM mapping and per-route encryption flows.
- If Acme wants a phased approach (hosted first), we can publish a tight plan to migrate to Private within 2 weeks after security sign-off, provided there are no infra changes. That gives a path to keep the functional acceptance inside the original window.

Risk log (quick, high level):
1) Risk ID R-001: KMS/HSM validation — Probability: High; Impact: High (delay to acceptance). Mitigation: Provide attestations + live walkthrough; fallback: phased hosted-first acceptance lane.
2) Risk ID R-002: Procurement budget approval tied to go-live — Probability: Medium; Impact: Medium (billing start disputes). Mitigation: commercial credit or billing start deferral option.
3) Risk ID R-003: Integration test failures during acceptance — Probability: Medium; Impact: Medium. Mitigation: reserve 48-hour debug window and pre-approved escalation contacts.

I recommend we document the updated MAP with conditional gates and an explicit "phased acceptance" lane. Marissa — I can produce a single-page risk appendix to attach to the MAP after the walkthrough.

–Karthik
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle@acmehealth.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP re-scope and slippage waterfall — proposed rebaseline & escalation

Danielle/Alex — thanks again for the walkthrough and candid feedback. Summary / decisions: 

1) Evidence delivered: SOC2 excerpt, network diagram, per-route logging sample (see attached).
2) Security "watchlist" items addressed live; formal HSM attestations to land in 48 hours (Karthik).
3) Agreement: phased acceptance lane accepted — functional validation on hosted (no billing start change), private deploy migration to follow after HSM attestation.
4) Commercial: Redwood will offer a one-time mitigation credit equal to 10% of month-1 invoice in the event the private deploy is delayed >10 business days beyond agreed sign-off, as long as Acme keeps hosted validation active. This preserves your exec narrative while aligning incentives.

Attached is the updated MAP (MAP-v2a) with the slippage waterfall and explicit gating language plus a 1-page risk appendix. Please confirm acceptance of the revised MAP and the commercial credit terms by EOD Friday so we can lock procurement and legal redlines.

If we don't hear back, we'll assume the phased lane is acceptable and will proceed to schedule the private deploy migration timeline contingent on HSM attestation.

Regards,
Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

----
